I now have a thorough understanding of every source file in the repository. Here is my detailed report.

---

## Tutors Course Builder -- Detailed Feature Report

**Repository:** [tutors-sdk/tutors-course-builder](https://github.com/tutors-sdk/tutors-course-builder)

**Stack:** Next.js 16 (App Router) + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS 4 + shadcn/ui + JSZip + YAML. Entirely client-side -- no backend, no authentication, no server persistence. Package manager is pnpm.

---

### 1. Course Authoring (Visual Structure Editor)

The core feature is a browser-based WYSIWYG course builder organized around the Tutors learning object (Lo) hierarchy. The application presents a two-pane Edit view:

- **Sidebar tree** (`components/builder/course-tree.tsx`): A collapsible tree that mirrors the course hierarchy. The root node is the Course itself, and below it sit Topics, which contain Units/Sides, which contain resource-type learning objects. Each tree row shows a type-specific icon with per-type accent colors (defined in `components/builder/lo-meta.tsx`) and the Lo title.

- **Editor pane** (`components/builder/lo-editor.tsx`): When a tree node is selected, the right pane shows a form tailored to that Lo type. Every Lo gets Title and Markdown content fields. Additional type-specific fields appear conditionally:
  - **Web link:** a URL input field (exported as a `weburl` file)
  - **GitHub:** a repository id field (exported as `githubid`)
  - **Panel Video:** a YouTube video ID field (exported as `videoid`)
  - **Podcast:** an audio URL text field plus an audio file uploader
  - **Talk / Tutorial / Panel Talk:** a PDF file uploader for slides
  - **Archive:** a ZIP file uploader
  - **Lab:** a dedicated lab step editor (described below)
  - Most types also get a card-image uploader

**File:** `components/builder/lo-editor.tsx` (generic editor), `components/builder/editors/course-editor.tsx` (course root), `components/builder/editors/lab-editor.tsx` (lab steps).

---

### 2. Supported Learning Object Types (15 types)

Defined in `lib/course-builder/types.ts`, the builder supports the full Tutors Lo taxonomy:

| Type | Purpose | Type-specific fields |
|------|---------|---------------------|
| `course` | Root object | title, markdown, image, properties (credits, companions, labStepsAutoNumber, iconset) |
| `topic` | Major content grouping | children (units/sides/resources) |
| `unit` | Horizontal sub-grouping | children (resources only) |
| `side` | Side unit variant | children (resources only) |
| `talk` | Slide deck presentation | PDF asset |
| `lab` | Multi-step lab exercise | steps[] (each with shortTitle + markdown), images[] |
| `note` | Standalone markdown document | (markdown only) |
| `web` | External link | url string |
| `github` | Repository link | repoId string |
| `archive` | Downloadable file | zip asset |
| `tutorial` | Markdown + optional PDF | PDF asset |
| `panelvideo` | Inline video on topic page | videoId (YouTube) |
| `paneltalk` | Inline talk on topic page | PDF asset |
| `panelnote` | Inline note on topic page | (markdown only) |
| `podcast` | Audio content | audioUrl string + optional audio asset |

The type system is a discriminated union on the `type` field, enabling exhaustive handling throughout the codebase.

---

### 3. Lab Step Editor

`components/builder/editors/lab-editor.tsx` provides a specialized editor for lab-type Los:

- **Step list sidebar:** Numbered step tiles (00, 01, 02...) with the step's short title. Each step can be reordered up/down or deleted.
- **Step content editor:** The selected step gets a full markdown editor (with Write/Preview/Split tabs).
- **Step short title:** Each step has a configurable short title used to derive the exported filename (e.g., `02.Setup.md`).
- **Add step:** Appends a new step with default content.
- **Step images:** A separate card lets authors upload images into an `img/` folder. These are referenced from step markdown as `img/filename.png`. Each image can be individually removed.

New labs are pre-populated with two steps (Intro and Step 1) via the `createLabStep` factory in `lib/course-builder/defaults.ts`.

---

### 4. Markdown Editor (Write / Preview / Split)

`components/builder/markdown-editor.tsx` provides a three-tab markdown editing experience used throughout the builder:

- **Write tab:** A plain `<textarea>` with monospace font.
- **Preview tab:** Renders the markdown using `react-markdown` with the `remark-gfm` plugin (supporting tables, strikethrough, task lists, etc.). Styled with prose-like Tailwind classes for headings, lists, code blocks, tables, blockquotes, and links.
- **Split tab:** Side-by-side writer and preview on wider screens.

Each Lo type gets contextual hints about what the markdown field represents (e.g., "Summary shown on the topic card (topic.md)" for topics).

---

### 5. Asset Management (IndexedDB)

`lib/course-builder/assets.ts` implements binary asset storage using IndexedDB (database name: `tutors-course-builder`, object store: `assets`):

- **`saveAsset(file)`** -- stores a File/Blob in IndexedDB and returns an `AssetRef` (id, name, mimeType, size).
- **`getAsset(id)`** -- retrieves a Blob by id.
- **`deleteAsset(id)`** -- removes an asset.
- **`getAssetUrl(id)`** -- creates an object URL for previewing.

The course model stores only lightweight `AssetRef` objects (never raw blobs), so the JSON in localStorage stays small while large binaries (images, PDFs, ZIPs, audio) go into IndexedDB.

`components/builder/asset-upload.tsx` is the reusable upload component used everywhere. It supports:
- Click-to-upload with a file picker
- Showing existing asset info (name, formatted size)
- Image preview when `imagePreview` is true
- Replace and Remove buttons
- Configurable `accept` mime types

---

### 6. Course Structure Operations (Tree CRUD)

Via the reducer in `lib/course-builder/store.tsx`, the builder supports:

- **Add Lo** (`add-lo` action): Context-aware add menus in the tree. Topics can be added at the root; units, sides, and all 11 resource types can be added under a topic; only resource types under a unit or side. The new Lo is created via `createLo()` with sensible defaults and is immediately selected for editing.
- **Delete Lo** (`delete-lo` action): Removes a Lo from its parent's children list. Selection automatically falls back to the Course root if the deleted item was selected.
- **Reorder Lo** (`move-lo` action): Move up/down buttons shift a Lo within its sibling list (direction: -1 or +1).
- **Update Lo** (`update-lo` action): Patches any field on a Lo.
- **Update Course** (`update-course` action): Patches course-level fields (title, markdown, image, properties).
- **New Course** (`new-course` action): Replaces with a blank course.
- **Sample Course** (`sample-course` action): Replaces with a pre-built sample course containing one topic ("Introduction") with a talk, a lab, and a web link pointing to tutors.dev.
- **Load Course** (`load` action): Replaces the entire course (used by import).

---

### 7. Persistence (Autosave to localStorage)

`lib/course-builder/store.tsx` implements automatic persistence:

- **Autosave:** A debounced effect (400ms) saves the entire course JSON to `localStorage` under the key `tutors-course-builder:course` after every state change.
- **Selection persistence:** The current selection (which Lo is being edited) is saved separately to `tutors-course-builder:selection`.
- **Rehydration:** On mount, the provider reads both keys from localStorage and restores the course and selection state.
- **Graceful degradation:** If localStorage is corrupted or quota is exceeded, errors are silently caught.

---

### 8. ZIP Import (Course Ingestion)

`lib/course-builder/import.ts` implements `importCourseZip(file)`:

- **Accepts:** A `.zip` file of a Tutors course source folder (the same structure used by `tutors-publish`).
- **Root detection:** Tolerates GitHub-style archives with a wrapping root folder (e.g., `repo-main/`). If `course.md` is not at the ZIP root, it checks whether all files share a single parent directory and strips it.
- **Filtering:** Excludes `__MACOSX` folders.
- **Parsing:**
  - Reads `course.md` for title and description.
  - Reads `properties.yaml` / `properties.yml` for credits, `labStepsAutoNumber`, `iconset`, and companion links. Companion links are any YAML keys whose values start with `http://` or `https://`.
  - Extracts the course card image (first image file at root).
  - Recursively walks topic folders (recognized by folder name prefixes like `topic-`, `unit-`, `book-`, etc.).
  - Lab folders: reads numbered step files (`NN.ShortTitle.md`), sorted numerically, plus `img/` subfolder images.
  - Resource folders: reads type-specific files (`weburl`, `githubid`, `videoid`, `audiourl`, PDF, archive ZIP, audio).
  - All binary assets are stored in IndexedDB via `saveAsset`.
- **Output:** Returns the parsed `Course` object plus a list of non-fatal warning strings.
- **Error handling:** Throws if no `course.md` is found; returns warnings for missing properties, unrecognized folders, empty containers, etc.

The import dialog (`components/builder/import-dialog.tsx`) provides:
- Drag-and-drop or file picker
- Loading spinner during import
- Parse summary showing topic count and warning count
- Scrollable warning list
- "Load into builder" button to replace the current course
- Error display if the ZIP is not a valid Tutors course

---

### 9. ZIP Export (Course Generation)

`lib/course-builder/export.ts` implements `exportCourseZip(course)`:

- **Validation first:** `validateCourse()` walks the entire tree and produces a list of issues:
  - **Errors** (block export): no title, no topics.
  - **Warnings** (allow export): missing card images, missing PDFs, empty URLs, empty containers, missing video IDs, missing audio, etc.
- **Folder naming:** Each Lo gets a canonical folder name: `{prefix}-{NN}-{slug}` where NN is the zero-padded index and slug is derived from the title (lowercased, non-alphanumeric replaced with hyphens, max 40 chars).
- **Markdown heading sync:** The exported markdown always has its first `# ` heading updated to match the Lo's title field.
- **Emitted structure:**
  - Root: `course.md`, `properties.yaml`, `course.png` (or placeholder)
  - Topics: `topic-NN-slug/topic.md`, `topic-NN-slug/topic.png`
  - Units/Sides: `unit-N-slug/slug.md`
  - Talks: `talk-N-slug/talk.md`, `talk.pdf`, `talk.png`
  - Labs: `book-N-slug/00.Intro.md`, `01.Step1.md`, ..., `img/` subfolder
  - Notes: `note-N-slug/note.md`, `note.png`
  - Web links: `web-N-slug/web.md`, `weburl`, `web.png`
  - GitHub: `github-N-slug/github.md`, `githubid`, `github.png`
  - Archives: `archive-N-slug/archive.md`, `archives/file.zip`, `archive.png`
  - Panel videos: `panelvideo-N-slug/slug.md`, `videoid`
  - Podcasts: `podcast-N-slug/slug.md`, audio file or `audiourl`, `slug.png`
- **Placeholder images:** When a Lo has no image, a 320x320 teal PNG with a white "T" is generated via `<canvas>` and included.
- **properties.yaml generation:** Credits, companion links (key-value pairs), and `labStepsAutoNumber` are serialized using the `yaml` library.
- **Download:** `downloadBlob()` creates a temporary `<a>` tag, triggers the download, and revokes the object URL.

The export dialog (`components/builder/export-dialog.tsx`) shows:
- A validation report (errors in red, warnings in amber)
- Export is blocked if there are errors
- "Download ZIP" button triggers the export and auto-downloads

---

### 10. Reader-Fidelity Preview

`components/builder/course-preview.tsx` implements an in-app preview that mirrors how the Tutors Reader (NextJS) renders a course:

- **Course Home:** Shows the course image/initial, title, credits, and a card grid of all topics.
- **Topic Page:** Shows the topic title and summary, a card grid of standalone resources (not inside units), and unit sections with a hairline-divider heading and their own card grids.
- **LoCard:** Each card has a 144px image header (or fallback icon), a type label in monospace uppercase, the title, and a 2-line clamped summary. External link types (web, github, archive) render as `<a>` tags opening in new tabs; navigable types (topic, lab, non-external resources) render as buttons.
- **Lab Shell:** A two-column layout with a numbered step sidebar on the left and the step markdown on the right. Includes prev/next footer buttons and keyboard navigation (left/right arrow keys).
- **Lo Page View:** For talks/tutorials/paneltalks, shows an embedded PDF `<object>`. For panel videos, shows a YouTube `<iframe>`. For podcasts, shows an `<audio>` element. All show their markdown content.
- **Breadcrumb Navigation:** A sticky top bar with breadcrumbs (Course > Topic > Lo) allowing navigation back up the tree.
- **Edit Integration:** An "Edit" button in the breadcrumb bar switches to the Edit tab with that Lo selected.
- **Navigation reset:** The preview navigation stack resets when the course identity changes (new/import/sample).

---

### 11. Course Properties Editor

`components/builder/editors/course-editor.tsx` provides the course-level metadata editor:

- **Title:** Text input.
- **Description:** Full markdown editor (course.md content).
- **Card image:** Image upload with preview (course.png).
- **Credits:** Text input (author/institution, mapped to `properties.yaml`).
- **Auto-number lab steps:** Toggle switch for `labStepsAutoNumber` in `properties.yaml`.
- **Companion links:** A dynamic list of key/URL pairs (e.g., moodle, youtube, zoom, teams). Each entry has a key input, URL input, and delete button. An "Add link" button appends a new empty entry. These get serialized as top-level keys in `properties.yaml`.

---

### 12. New Course / Sample Course

From the header bar (`components/builder/builder-shell.tsx`):

- **New:** Creates a blank course with the title "My New Course", default markdown, default properties (credits: "Your name here", labStepsAutoNumber: true, iconset: "fluentui"), and no topics.
- **Sample:** Creates a reference course titled "Reference Course" with one topic ("Introduction") containing a talk ("Welcome Talk"), a lab ("Lab 01 - Setup" with two steps), and a web link ("Tutors Website" pointing to tutors.dev).
- Both show a confirmation dialog warning that the current course will be replaced.

---

### 13. Responsive Design

The layout adapts to screen size:
- **Desktop (md+):** Fixed 288px sidebar + fluid editor pane.
- **Mobile:** The sidebar becomes a collapsible `<details>` element at the top, with a max height of 320px and scrolling.
- Header buttons show icons only on narrow screens, full text on wider screens.

---

### 14. Dark/Light Theme Support

The `layout.tsx` sets `class="bg-background"` on `<html>` and uses CSS custom properties for theming. The `app/globals.css` file (4.4KB) defines light and dark theme tokens. Icons in `/public` include both `icon-light-32x32.png` and `icon-dark-32x32.png` favicons that respond to `prefers-color-scheme`.

---

### 15. Round-Trip Compatibility

The import and export systems are deliberately symmetric:

- A course exported from the builder can be re-imported losslessly.
- A real Tutors course repo (e.g., `tutors-reference-course`) can be imported directly from its GitHub ZIP download.
- The exported ZIP is immediately consumable by `tutors-publish` from the tutors-apps toolchain to generate the JSON that the Tutors Reader serves.

---

### 16. Analytics

In production builds only, Vercel Analytics is included (`@vercel/analytics` v1.6.1), injected conditionally in `layout.tsx`.

---

| Concern | Technology |
|---------|-----------|
| Framework | Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19 |

| Styling | Tailwind CSS 4, tw-animate-css |

---

## Tutors Course Builder -- Detailed Feature Report

**Repository:** [tutors-sdk/tutors-course-builder](https://github.com/tutors-sdk/tutors-course-builder)

**Stack:** Next.js 16 (App Router) + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS 4 + shadcn/ui + JSZip + YAML. Entirely client-side -- no backend, no authentication, no server persistence. Package manager is pnpm.

---

### 1. Course Authoring (Visual Structure Editor)

The core feature is a browser-based WYSIWYG course builder organized around the Tutors learning object (Lo) hierarchy. The application presents a two-pane Edit view:

- **Sidebar tree** (`components/builder/course-tree.tsx`): A collapsible tree that mirrors the course hierarchy. The root node is the Course itself, and below it sit Topics, which contain Units/Sides, which contain resource-type learning objects. Each tree row shows a type-specific icon with per-type accent colors (defined in `components/builder/lo-meta.tsx`) and the Lo title.

- **Editor pane** (`components/builder/lo-editor.tsx`): When a tree node is selected, the right pane shows a form tailored to that Lo type. Every Lo gets Title and Markdown content fields. Additional type-specific fields appear conditionally:
  - **Web link:** a URL input field (exported as a `weburl` file)
  - **GitHub:** a repository id field (exported as `githubid`)
  - **Panel Video:** a YouTube video ID field (exported as `videoid`)
  - **Podcast:** an audio URL text field plus an audio file uploader
  - **Talk / Tutorial / Panel Talk:** a PDF file uploader for slides
  - **Archive:** a ZIP file uploader
  - **Lab:** a dedicated lab step editor (described below)
  - Most types also get a card-image uploader

**File:** `components/builder/lo-editor.tsx` (generic editor), `components/builder/editors/course-editor.tsx` (course root), `components/builder/editors/lab-editor.tsx` (lab steps).

---

### 2. Supported Learning Object Types (15 types)

Defined in `lib/course-builder/types.ts`, the builder supports the full Tutors Lo taxonomy:

| Type | Purpose | Type-specific fields |
|------|---------|---------------------|
| `course` | Root object | title, markdown, image, properties (credits, companions, labStepsAutoNumber, iconset) |
| `topic` | Major content grouping | children (units/sides/resources) |
| `unit` | Horizontal sub-grouping | children (resources only) |
| `side` | Side unit variant | children (resources only) |
| `talk` | Slide deck presentation | PDF asset |
| `lab` | Multi-step lab exercise | steps[] (each with shortTitle + markdown), images[] |
| `note` | Standalone markdown document | (markdown only) |
| `web` | External link | url string |
| `github` | Repository link | repoId string |
| `archive` | Downloadable file | zip asset |
| `tutorial` | Markdown + optional PDF | PDF asset |
| `panelvideo` | Inline video on topic page | videoId (YouTube) |
| `paneltalk` | Inline talk on topic page | PDF asset |
| `panelnote` | Inline note on topic page | (markdown only) |
| `podcast` | Audio content | audioUrl string + optional audio asset |

The type system is a discriminated union on the `type` field, enabling exhaustive handling throughout the codebase.

---

### 3. Lab Step Editor

`components/builder/editors/lab-editor.tsx` provides a specialized editor for lab-type Los:

- **Step list sidebar:** Numbered step tiles (00, 01, 02...) with the step's short title. Each step can be reordered up/down or deleted.
- **Step content editor:** The selected step gets a full markdown editor (with Write/Preview/Split tabs).
- **Step short title:** Each step has a configurable short title used to derive the exported filename (e.g., `02.Setup.md`).
- **Add step:** Appends a new step with default content.
- **Step images:** A separate card lets authors upload images into an `img/` folder. These are referenced from step markdown as `img/filename.png`. Each image can be individually removed.

New labs are pre-populated with two steps (Intro and Step 1) via the `createLabStep` factory in `lib/course-builder/defaults.ts`.

---

### 4. Markdown Editor (Write / Preview / Split)

`components/builder/markdown-editor.tsx` provides a three-tab markdown editing experience used throughout the builder:

- **Write tab:** A plain `<textarea>` with monospace font.
- **Preview tab:** Renders the markdown using `react-markdown` with the `remark-gfm` plugin (supporting tables, strikethrough, task lists, etc.). Styled with prose-like Tailwind classes for headings, lists, code blocks, tables, blockquotes, and links.
- **Split tab:** Side-by-side writer and preview on wider screens.

Each Lo type gets contextual hints about what the markdown field represents (e.g., "Summary shown on the topic card (topic.md)" for topics).

---

### 5. Asset Management (IndexedDB)

`lib/course-builder/assets.ts` implements binary asset storage using IndexedDB (database name: `tutors-course-builder`, object store: `assets`):

- **`saveAsset(file)`** -- stores a File/Blob in IndexedDB and returns an `AssetRef` (id, name, mimeType, size).
- **`getAsset(id)`** -- retrieves a Blob by id.
- **`deleteAsset(id)`** -- removes an asset.
- **`getAssetUrl(id)`** -- creates an object URL for previewing.

The course model stores only lightweight `AssetRef` objects (never raw blobs), so the JSON in localStorage stays small while large binaries (images, PDFs, ZIPs, audio) go into IndexedDB.

`components/builder/asset-upload.tsx` is the reusable upload component used everywhere. It supports:
- Click-to-upload with a file picker
- Showing existing asset info (name, formatted size)
- Image preview when `imagePreview` is true
- Replace and Remove buttons
- Configurable `accept` mime types

---

### 6. Course Structure Operations (Tree CRUD)

Via the reducer in `lib/course-builder/store.tsx`, the builder supports:

- **Add Lo** (`add-lo` action): Context-aware add menus in the tree. Topics can be added at the root; units, sides, and all 11 resource types can be added under a topic; only resource types under a unit or side. The new Lo is created via `createLo()` with sensible defaults and is immediately selected for editing.
- **Delete Lo** (`delete-lo` action): Removes a Lo from its parent's children list. Selection automatically falls back to the Course root if the deleted item was selected.
- **Reorder Lo** (`move-lo` action): Move up/down buttons shift a Lo within its sibling list (direction: -1 or +1).
- **Update Lo** (`update-lo` action): Patches any field on a Lo.
- **Update Course** (`update-course` action): Patches course-level fields (title, markdown, image, properties).
- **New Course** (`new-course` action): Replaces with a blank course.
- **Sample Course** (`sample-course` action): Replaces with a pre-built sample course containing one topic ("Introduction") with a talk, a lab, and a web link pointing to tutors.dev.
- **Load Course** (`load` action): Replaces the entire course (used by import).

---

### 7. Persistence (Autosave to localStorage)

`lib/course-builder/store.tsx` implements automatic persistence:

- **Autosave:** A debounced effect (400ms) saves the entire course JSON to `localStorage` under the key `tutors-course-builder:course` after every state change.
- **Selection persistence:** The current selection (which Lo is being edited) is saved separately to `tutors-course-builder:selection`.
- **Rehydration:** On mount, the provider reads both keys from localStorage and restores the course and selection state.
- **Graceful degradation:** If localStorage is corrupted or quota is exceeded, errors are silently caught.

---

### 8. ZIP Import (Course Ingestion)

`lib/course-builder/import.ts` implements `importCourseZip(file)`:

- **Accepts:** A `.zip` file of a Tutors course source folder (the same structure used by `tutors-publish`).
- **Root detection:** Tolerates GitHub-style archives with a wrapping root folder (e.g., `repo-main/`). If `course.md` is not at the ZIP root, it checks whether all files share a single parent directory and strips it.
- **Filtering:** Excludes `__MACOSX` folders.
- **Parsing:**
  - Reads `course.md` for title and description.
  - Reads `properties.yaml` / `properties.yml` for credits, `labStepsAutoNumber`, `iconset`, and companion links. Companion links are any YAML keys whose values start with `http://` or `https://`.
  - Extracts the course card image (first image file at root).
  - Recursively walks topic folders (recognized by folder name prefixes like `topic-`, `unit-`, `book-`, etc.).
  - Lab folders: reads numbered step files (`NN.ShortTitle.md`), sorted numerically, plus `img/` subfolder images.
  - Resource folders: reads type-specific files (`weburl`, `githubid`, `videoid`, `audiourl`, PDF, archive ZIP, audio).
  - All binary assets are stored in IndexedDB via `saveAsset`.
- **Output:** Returns the parsed `Course` object plus a list of non-fatal warning strings.
- **Error handling:** Throws if no `course.md` is found; returns warnings for missing properties, unrecognized folders, empty containers, etc.

The import dialog (`components/builder/import-dialog.tsx`) provides:
- Drag-and-drop or file picker
- Loading spinner during import
- Parse summary showing topic count and warning count
- Scrollable warning list
- "Load into builder" button to replace the current course
- Error display if the ZIP is not a valid Tutors course

---

### 9. ZIP Export (Course Generation)

`lib/course-builder/export.ts` implements `exportCourseZip(course)`:

- **Validation first:** `validateCourse()` walks the entire tree and produces a list of issues:
  - **Errors** (block export): no title, no topics.
  - **Warnings** (allow export): missing card images, missing PDFs, empty URLs, empty containers, missing video IDs, missing audio, etc.
- **Folder naming:** Each Lo gets a canonical folder name: `{prefix}-{NN}-{slug}` where NN is the zero-padded index and slug is derived from the title (lowercased, non-alphanumeric replaced with hyphens, max 40 chars).
- **Markdown heading sync:** The exported markdown always has its first `# ` heading updated to match the Lo's title field.
- **Emitted structure:**
  - Root: `course.md`, `properties.yaml`, `course.png` (or placeholder)
  - Topics: `topic-NN-slug/topic.md`, `topic-NN-slug/topic.png`
  - Units/Sides: `unit-N-slug/slug.md`
  - Talks: `talk-N-slug/talk.md`, `talk.pdf`, `talk.png`
  - Labs: `book-N-slug/00.Intro.md`, `01.Step1.md`, ..., `img/` subfolder
  - Notes: `note-N-slug/note.md`, `note.png`
  - Web links: `web-N-slug/web.md`, `weburl`, `web.png`
  - GitHub: `github-N-slug/github.md`, `githubid`, `github.png`
  - Archives: `archive-N-slug/archive.md`, `archives/file.zip`, `archive.png`
  - Panel videos: `panelvideo-N-slug/slug.md`, `videoid`
  - Podcasts: `podcast-N-slug/slug.md`, audio file or `audiourl`, `slug.png`
- **Placeholder images:** When a Lo has no image, a 320x320 teal PNG with a white "T" is generated via `<canvas>` and included.
- **properties.yaml generation:** Credits, companion links (key-value pairs), and `labStepsAutoNumber` are serialized using the `yaml` library.
- **Download:** `downloadBlob()` creates a temporary `<a>` tag, triggers the download, and revokes the object URL.

The export dialog (`components/builder/export-dialog.tsx`) shows:
- A validation report (errors in red, warnings in amber)
- Export is blocked if there are errors
- "Download ZIP" button triggers the export and auto-downloads

---

### 10. Reader-Fidelity Preview

`components/builder/course-preview.tsx` implements an in-app preview that mirrors how the Tutors Reader (NextJS) renders a course:

- **Course Home:** Shows the course image/initial, title, credits, and a card grid of all topics.
- **Topic Page:** Shows the topic title and summary, a card grid of standalone resources (not inside units), and unit sections with a hairline-divider heading and their own card grids.
- **LoCard:** Each card has a 144px image header (or fallback icon), a type label in monospace uppercase, the title, and a 2-line clamped summary. External link types (web, github, archive) render as `<a>` tags opening in new tabs; navigable types (topic, lab, non-external resources) render as buttons.
- **Lab Shell:** A two-column layout with a numbered step sidebar on the left and the step markdown on the right. Includes prev/next footer buttons and keyboard navigation (left/right arrow keys).
- **Lo Page View:** For talks/tutorials/paneltalks, shows an embedded PDF `<object>`. For panel videos, shows a YouTube `<iframe>`. For podcasts, shows an `<audio>` element. All show their markdown content.
- **Breadcrumb Navigation:** A sticky top bar with breadcrumbs (Course > Topic > Lo) allowing navigation back up the tree.
- **Edit Integration:** An "Edit" button in the breadcrumb bar switches to the Edit tab with that Lo selected.
- **Navigation reset:** The preview navigation stack resets when the course identity changes (new/import/sample).

---

### 11. Course Properties Editor

`components/builder/editors/course-editor.tsx` provides the course-level metadata editor:

- **Title:** Text input.
- **Description:** Full markdown editor (course.md content).
- **Card image:** Image upload with preview (course.png).
- **Credits:** Text input (author/institution, mapped to `properties.yaml`).
- **Auto-number lab steps:** Toggle switch for `labStepsAutoNumber` in `properties.yaml`.
- **Companion links:** A dynamic list of key/URL pairs (e.g., moodle, youtube, zoom, teams). Each entry has a key input, URL input, and delete button. An "Add link" button appends a new empty entry. These get serialized as top-level keys in `properties.yaml`.

---

### 12. New Course / Sample Course

From the header bar (`components/builder/builder-shell.tsx`):

- **New:** Creates a blank course with the title "My New Course", default markdown, default properties (credits: "Your name here", labStepsAutoNumber: true, iconset: "fluentui"), and no topics.
- **Sample:** Creates a reference course titled "Reference Course" with one topic ("Introduction") containing a talk ("Welcome Talk"), a lab ("Lab 01 - Setup" with two steps), and a web link ("Tutors Website" pointing to tutors.dev).
- Both show a confirmation dialog warning that the current course will be replaced.

---

### 13. Responsive Design

The layout adapts to screen size:
- **Desktop (md+):** Fixed 288px sidebar + fluid editor pane.
- **Mobile:** The sidebar becomes a collapsible `<details>` element at the top, with a max height of 320px and scrolling.
- Header buttons show icons only on narrow screens, full text on wider screens.

---

### 14. Dark/Light Theme Support

The `layout.tsx` sets `class="bg-background"` on `<html>` and uses CSS custom properties for theming. The `app/globals.css` file (4.4KB) defines light and dark theme tokens. Icons in `/public` include both `icon-light-32x32.png` and `icon-dark-32x32.png` favicons that respond to `prefers-color-scheme`.

---

### 15. Round-Trip Compatibility

The import and export systems are deliberately symmetric:

- A course exported from the builder can be re-imported losslessly.
- A real Tutors course repo (e.g., `tutors-reference-course`) can be imported directly from its GitHub ZIP download.
- The exported ZIP is immediately consumable by `tutors-publish` from the tutors-apps toolchain to generate the JSON that the Tutors Reader serves.

---

### 16. Analytics

In production builds only, Vercel Analytics is included (`@vercel/analytics` v1.6.1), injected conditionally in `layout.tsx`.

---

|---------|-----------|
| Framework | Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19 |
| Language | TypeScript 5.7 |
| Styling | Tailwind CSS 4, tw-animate-css |

| Icons | lucide-react |
| Markdown rendering | react-markdown + remark-gfm |
